Mapzen Terrain Tiles; SRTM/GMTED2010 USGS; ETOPO1 NOAA
limitations: Municipal Los Angeles relation 207359, not Los Angeles County or the entire metropolitan area.
OSM geometry is incomplete; untagged heights, building facades and interiors are procedural.
Fixed Shenzhen projection preserves existing saves; east-west scale in Los Angeles differs from 1 block/metre.
32-metre resampled DEM; civic core is flat with a 128-metre terrain blend; elevations above 1287 metres are capped.
Only newly generated chunks receive the map; existing chunks are preserved.
